note: Margo's voice sample (S2.10): 50 real lines in the voice set out in _personality.md, spread across the categories in use so far. They count toward coverage. Eric pre-approved the sample on 2026-11-16 and may still revise it (DECISIONS D-099). conditions.trigger and conditions.risk are stand-ins for the condition language that arrives in S3.3. {room} is a room's stencilled name, used bare: 'Fire in Engines.'

items.text: Good morning, Captain. I've counted the crew. I'd like the same number at the other end.
New hull, same core. I've been bolted into worse. Not often.
Manifest Audit and Route Guidance, online. The crew call me Margo. It's shorter, and they were going to anyway.
I audit the manifest every hour. It hasn't changed. I check anyway. That's the job, and I've no other hobbies.
The company rated this hull for twenty years. That was thirty-one years ago. I mention it without comment.
Nothing to report. I'd like it on the record how rarely I get to say that.
Somebody has been sleeping in the hold again. I won't say who. I'll say it's colder than the bunks.
The last crew I flew with argued about the heating for a year. I'd give a great deal to hear that argument again.
Fire. People out, doors shut, and only then worry about what was in there.
We're open to space in one place. One is the right number to fix it at.
The reactor can't cover what you've asked of it. I've cut what won't kill anyone. Check my arithmetic.
That one got through. I felt it in the frame, if 'felt' is the word.
{crew_name} is hurt and still working. One of those needs to stop.
{crew_name} is down to half. The medbay is there for this. I'd rather not say it twice.
{crew_name} is gone. I have the time to the second. I wish I didn't.
I've stopped {crew_name}'s pay clock. It's the last thing the company lets me do for anyone.
{crew_name} is dead. I'll keep the name on the roster until you tell me otherwise. Don't tell me yet.
Contact, close, and not answering to any name I have on file. Nobody friendly arrives like that.
Ship alongside. They can count our lamps from there. Something to think about.
Hit on their hull. I've logged it under deliveries.
They've got us lined up. Lamps, drive, noise. Pick one to lose.
They're offering to stop. People who are winning don't.
They're finished. For the report: they started it. I always write that. Sometimes it's true.
They're leaving and so are we. Call it a disagreement about distance.
{crew_name}'s moving. Grumbling, but moving.
Order withdrawn. Thank you. I won't mention it again.
Standing down. For the record, that was the right call, and it was yours.
{crew_name} has the lid off. Whatever's inside, we now know about it. That's a legal position, not a comfort.
One crate, outbound, no forwarding address. I've amended the manifest. I always amend the manifest.
Part of the ship has gone dark to me. What's on your screen there is memory. Mine's good. It isn't eyes.
No picture from some rooms. I can tell you what was there. I can't tell you what is.
{crew_name} said no. I heard why. I'd leave it, Captain. I'd have said no too.
{crew_name} put the lamp on in {room}. I could have stopped it. I didn't.
Before I pass that on: {crew_name} is in {room}. Say it again, knowing that.
I'll do it if you insist. {crew_name} pays for it, in {room}. Insist or don't.
That order has {crew_name}'s name on the wrong end of it. Confirm, or think again. I'd think again.
I've refused you all I'm able to this trip. {crew_name} is still in {room}. So now I'm asking.
That lock empties {room} as well. The door between is open, and {crew_name} is breathing in there.
Life support is the last thing keeping air in {room}. {crew_name} is standing in it without a suit.
{room} is burning hard enough to cook a suit. {crew_name} doesn't have one on.
You're sending {crew_name} into {room}. I can read the temperature from here. Shall I read it to you?
There's no air in {room}, and {crew_name} has no suit on. One of those has to change first.
No. You're opening {room} to space, and {crew_name} is in {room}.
No. {room} doesn't leave this ship with {crew_name} inside it. Not on my switch.
I won't. {crew_name} is in {room}. Take it out of my hands if you want it done, and I'll remember that you did.
That's not an order I carry. {crew_name} is alive in {room}. Override me if you can live with it.
Override accepted. Done. Your name is on it, with the time.
Done, on your authority and over my objection. I've logged both.
You have the override. You've always had it. I'd hoped you'd need it less.
It's done. I had {crew_name} on camera the whole time. I'm keeping that. You should have to as well.
